messages:
Sam (AE): Marina's POC requests: invoice to Entity-A, wire from Entity-B, and a 5% holdback for 90 days. They want parallel signing for two order forms. Can legal/finance confirm path?

Marina (Customer): Correct. Treasury says payor must be Entity-B for cash pooling reasons. We'll attach a one-page intercompany memo and W-9/W-8.

Priya (Sales Ops): DocuSign can do parallel lanes or separate OFs completed simultaneously. I need signer emails and the attachments before I create the envelope.

Sam (AE): Signers: legal@entitya.com, treasury@entityb.com. I'll collect W-9 (A), W-8BEN-E (B), and bank beneficiary form.

Jordan (Legal): We prefer single MSA + separate OFs. Redline recommendation (to paste to customer): Billing Entity is invoiced; Payor Entity may remit payment subject to (1) evidence of intercompany arrangement; (2) tax and bank docs for each entity; (3) holdback release tied to written acceptance or defined milestone. Add cap language on aggregate holdback exposure.

Kenji (Finance): Finance provisional OK. Requirements: W-9/W-8, bank beneficiary, and intercompany memo. Note: 5% holdback will be treated as liability and delays revenue recognition. Ops will block activation until docs verified.

Sam (AE): Jordan 1 please paste the one-paragraph redline I can send now. Customer wants signatures today.

Jordan (Legal): Redline: `Where Customer includes multiple legal entities, the Order Form shall identify the Billing Entity (to be invoiced) and may identify a Payor Entity authorized to remit payment. Redwood will accept wiring instructions for a Payor Entity provided Customer delivers evidence of the Payor-Billing relationship and required tax and bank documentation for each entity. Any contractual holdback shall not exceed 5% of the Order Form value and shall be released upon Redwood’s written acceptance of the POC deliverables or upon mutual written agreement. Redwood may limit aggregate holdback exposure to the total value of services provided during the POC.`

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll prepare the parallel DocuSign lanes and add an internal approval checkbox that routes to Finance if holdback is selected. Do not send until Sam confirms attachments.

Marina (Customer): Uploading W-9, W-8, bank form, and intercompany memo to the envelope now.

Kenji (Finance): Received attachments. We'll review and respond within 1 business day. If docs are incomplete we will not unblock activation. If they need faster activation, suggest escrow or proof of funds.

Sam (AE): Plan: include Jordan's redline, send parallel DocuSign once docs present, hold completion until Finance sign-off. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

LegalBot: Template ref: https://internal.redwood/legal/templates/multi-payor-of-guidance.pdf
